node.statement: Product naturality and the fourth-term bound. Node 1.2.1 gives T_n(x),T_n(y) in S_{P_n}=M_n tensor S_P. If A=[a_ij] and B=[b_ij] lie there, the level-n product obtained by amplifying the compressed product on S_P has entries sum_k Co_P(a_ik b_kj), which by linearity equal Co_P(sum_k a_ik b_kj). Thus A dot_n B=(id_{M_n} tensor Co_P)(AB)=Co_{P_n}(AB), using lem-compcb-amplified-compression. It is therefore exactly the compatible square-corner product estimated by lem-compcb-rectangular-product, not a different product. Consequently ||T_n(x)T_n(y)-T_n(x) dot_n T_n(y)||<=C_r*e||T_n(x)|| ||T_n(y)||<=C_r*(1+K_N)^2*e||x||||y||, where node 1.4 and e<=1 give the last inequality.
node.inference: matrix-product computation and external rectangular estimate
